title: Remove Coda and Semio Imports From Elements UI
description: Remove all coda and semio imports from elements/ui. Refactor cleanly so elements/ui is fully self-contained with no dependencies on @semio/* or coda packages.
summary: Removed all @semio and @coda imports from elements/ui. Replaced @semio/assets/icons import in index.tsx with direct lucide-react imports using the same semantic aliases. Replaced @semio/assets dependency with lucide-react in package.json. Removed @semio/assets path aliases from tsconfig.json. Removed @coda/desktop alias from .storybook/main.ts. TypeScript compilation passes cleanly with zero errors.
